title: RBI imposes monetary penalty on Mandya District Co-operative Central Bank Ltd., Karnataka
description: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has, by an order dated July 17, 2026, imposed a monetary penalty of ₹50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) on Mandya District Co-operative Central Bank Ltd., Karnataka (the bank) for contravention of provisions of section 19 read with section 56 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949 (BR Act).
